summary: Diagnostics generation-9 enabled-state canonical evidence validates a disposable lab.model:Clone(), but Roblox Clone omits Archivable=false descendants. Because the helper does not prove clone completeness or fail closed on non-Archivable live truth before cloning, an unexpected live non-Archivable child can disappear before strict Validation.captureFull(clone) and evade the diagnostics-on evidence pass.
evidence: Inspected retained primary PR #424 exact head f89ce88ea7791e29d22a0e2ca76b22f2d7b63699 after its generation-9 enabled-integrity and authoritative-projection updates.

PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.captureCanonicalWhileDiagnosticsEnabled() proves the live owned diagnostics root exists, then immediately clones lab.model; it removes the cloned diagnostics root and runs unchanged strict Validation.captureFull(clone), but has no Archivable/clone-completeness guard before Clone().
Roblox Creator Hub Instance documentation states Archivable controls inclusion when Clone() is called on an ancestor and Clone() ignores descendants that are not Archivable.

Strict PhysicsLabValidation would reject an unexpected direct live child if it saw it, but a child with Archivable=false can be omitted by the disposable clone before that representation-set validation runs.

Draft stacked expected-red PR #425 exact head 73a32bba954775e89bcaeaee7ec6212334688ef9 changes only tests/physics_lab_diagnostics_enabled_integrity.luau (+25/-0) and requires fail-closed clone completeness before lab.model:Clone().
